facts.fact: Rachel 讲父亲 Dr. Randolph Horowitz：1931 年从奥地利来美、预感二战、把妻女留在维也纳
facts.anchor: His name was Dr. Randolph Horowitz. He came to this country from Austria in 1931.

facts.fact: Rachel 自述喜欢女人、战前 boxed in；战时 Los Alamos 的 camp 才找到献祭的 cause
facts.anchor: I liked women. I never doubted it, and I never thought it a problem.

facts.fact: 战后父亲活了二十年、被广岛长崎与未公开实验困扰；「知识背叛了他」
facts.anchor: He felt that knowledge itself had betrayed him—that he had been made to play its enabler.

facts.fact: 曼哈顿=公开，父亲的 Chicago 项目=隐秘
facts.anchor: But my father’s project—what they called ‘Chicago’—that was more discreet.

facts.fact: 电影源自摄影（记录/冻结时间、不需电）；电的发现带来 transmission（电话/电网/电视）
facts.anchor: But electricity offered something different. Something far grander. Transmission.

facts.fact: Hourglass Incident：20 世纪初 static men 现身于领袖、声称奉 The Distant Seer 之命、我们触怒了它
facts.anchor: ‘The Distant Seer,’ the static called it.

facts.fact: 静态给了 partnership 条款：屏幕=隔离墙、单向镜，把其他现实挡在玻璃后
facts.anchor: The screen. It was meant to serve as a dividing line. A one-way mirror

facts.fact: 系统需要燃料=某些电流异常强的人（crooked）；Rachel 父亲称之为 septic tank
facts.anchor: My father always called it simply ‘the septic tank.’ A place to put all that we must keep below.

facts.fact: 千千万万人被送下去、系统百年仍脆弱：发明越来越多种屏幕兜住静电
facts.anchor: we’ve invented more and more screens. Different screens. Screens of all sizes and types.

facts.fact: Bethany 问『PAA 到底是什么』——无人知道，没人回来过，只有 disturbances 漂流信号
facts.anchor: No one knows,” Rachel says. “I’m sorry. This unfortunately is left for you to find out

facts.fact: receiver 假说：十亿分之一概率的人电流强到系统关不住、像森林大火烧穿所有屏幕
facts.anchor: one in ten billion, by his best estimate
